howItWorks.title: One queue, three steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Appointments and walk-ins land in the same line, so nobody is served out of turn.

book.title: Customers book online or walk up to the kiosk
book.description: Online bookings get a confirmation code. Walk-ins take a printed or on-screen ticket with a QR code at the self-service kiosk.

call.title: Staff call the next person from one dashboard
call.description: Call next, mark served or no-show, and undo a slip — every action updates the line for everyone at once.

see.title: Everyone sees their place in line
see.description: Customers follow their position and estimated wait on their phone; the lobby screen shows who is being served and who is next.

capabilities.title: Everything a front desk needs to run the line

kiosk.title: Walk-in kiosk and online booking

checkIn.title: Check-in by code

virtual.title: Virtual queue
